title: Safe launcher process cleanup 1.0.10
summary: Launcher updates now terminate only Eclipse RolePlay Launcher processes, wait for file release, and preserve Minecraft, Java, and unrelated applications.
notes: Single-instance lock prevents duplicate launcher process trees.
NSIS closes the exact Eclipse RolePlay Launcher executable before replacement.
Minecraft, Java, Discord, browsers, and unrelated Electron apps are untouched.
Verified end-to-end with six running launcher processes and installer exit code 0.
